messages:
Sasha: Heads up — PrismRx reporting p99 spikes to ~1.2s on their dedicated embeddings pool in eu-west1, started ~10:05 UTC. They've flagged this P1 and want an ETA on mitigation.
Raj: Oncall here. I can reproduce the spikes in logs; KV cache invalidations line up with the 03/16 cache-key rollout (noticed churn in cache-ttl).
Mei: Runtime owner. I can hotpatch a cache-guard to reject stale keys, or revert the change. Revert needs a canary and ~30m to validate. Hotpatch is quicker but more surgical.
Omar: Infra: we can spin up a temporary dedicated pool (gpu-c3) in eu-west1 and shift traffic. Need runtime sign-off for routing policy and a brief window for cutover.
Lina: QA standing by to run targeted replays once a canary build is available. Will validate both latency and error surface.
Mei: Proposed action: 1) create new pool + route 10% traffic there 2) deploy cache-guard on canary runtime 3) run 15m validation (p99 & errors) 4) if stable, escalate to 50% then full cutover. Rough ETA: 45–60m.
Raj: Support note: PrismRx expects a fix within 2h. Support has their Prod Eng on standby. Please call out who is owning customer comms.
Sasha: I approve the plan. @Mei own runtime changes, @Omar prep infra pool, @Lina handle replay + validation, @Raj maintain customer comms.
Omar: Starting pool creation now. Command I'm using: `gcloud compute instances create --zone eu-west1-b --machine-type a2-highgpu-1g --labels=prismrx-temp-pool` — ETA ~6m, will post when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated by Mei on branch `prismx/cache-guard` to canary group. link: https://deploy.redwood.local/1234
Mei: CR link for quick review: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/456 — small guard around KV access, adds `cache_guard_enabled` flag. Ping @Raj for metric tag suggestion.
Raj: Reviewing now. Small nit: please add metric tag `customer=prismrx` to cache_miss counter so we can filter.
Lina: Starting replay against canary (1000 reqs/min). Baseline p99 on prod: ~1200ms; canary currently reporting 280ms.
Raj: LGTM on CR, merging now.
Mei: Merged and rolling canary to 10%.
Lina: After 10 minutes: canary p99 220ms, prod aggregate p99 dropped to ~700ms. No new errors in logs so far.
Sasha: Good. Confirming commitment to PrismRx: 1) full cutover within 1h assuming metrics hold, 2) RCA and postmortem by EOD. I'll update Support channel.
Omar: New pool scaled and ready; routing policy endpoint configured.
Mei: Requesting promote to 50%: `redwood deploy promote --canary 50`
deploy-bot: promotion complete. Routing now: 50% canary.
Lina: Monitoring after 8m at 50%: overall p99 ~330ms, error rate steady.
Raj: Please open a follow-up ticket to capture the migration gating logic and add a migration flag to future cache-key rollouts.
Mei: Created ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/PRISM-1423 — includes suggested mitigation and checklist.
Sasha: Thanks team — great execution. If anything regresses, reopen this thread and escalate. :thumbsup:
